binning.bin_order_string_TO_ASSERT: pt-major row-major: cell = i_pt * n_pparallel_bins + i_pparallel

NOT_the_paper_grid.artifacts_carry: 15 x 19 = 285 bins (extended FPS: pT to 30.0; p_parallel 0-0.75 and 60-120)

members.replica_index_source: the scalar INSIDE each NPZ -- never the filename, glob order, or readdir order
members.marker_known_limit: atomic_write.is_complete compares size and int(st_mtime) at WHOLE-SECOND resolution; a same-size same-second rewrite is invisible to it

do_not_trust.why: a hardcoded producer literal (lane C OI-66); call is_complete yourself

estimator.width_weighting_note: CSTAT-R1b: xsec is a density, so C has units cm^4/nucleon^2/(GeV/c)^4 and is NOT the covariance of the bin-integrated cross section; the two differ by diag(w) C diag(w) with w = outer(dpt, dpp) flattened

domain.why_union_not_intersection: the intersection silently deletes cells and its deletion set depends on N, so the published dimension would change with the member count
domain.reported_test: xsec != 0.0 (unreported cells are HARD-ZEROED at extract_fullevent_fps.py:517-518)
domain.cells_below_50_treatment: present in the published matrix, FLAGGED, excluded from any downstream inversion or chi2, cell list recorded by index -- not deleted, because deleting them would hide that the question was asked

mask_is_replica_dependent.mechanism: extract_fullevent_replica.py:190-196 monkey-patches completeness_2d so the replica signal Poisson factor multiplies weights INSIDE the completeness computation; comp > 0 is therefore a per-replica draw
mask_is_replica_dependent.why_it_matters: both builders given identical member vectors compute the identical wrong variance in a flickering cell and agree perfectly; element-wise agreement has NO power over this

measurements_provisional_at_N14.WARNING: measured on 14 of 50 members while array 56936015 was mid-flight; MUST be re-measured at 50/50 before publication. Quoted because the DECISIONS they drive are stable under the remaining 36.

CSTAT-O2_is_it_entitled_to_the_name_C_st.state: OPEN -- found by C while writing this spec; in C's judgement the more serious of the two
CSTAT-O2_is_it_entitled_to_the_name_C_st.network_is_unseeded: grep for set_seed across nd-unfolding/ and omnifold_nn/ returns NOTHING -- no tf.random.set_seed, no np.random.seed, no TF_DETERMINISTIC_OPS
CSTAT-O2_is_it_entitled_to_the_name_C_st.bootstrap_seed_governs: the draw and its provenance validation, NOT weight initialization, batch shuffling, or GPU reduction order
CSTAT-O2_is_it_entitled_to_the_name_C_st.consequence: each member differs in TWO ways at once -- its Poisson draw AND free-running training stochasticity. The matrix is C_stat + C_train + cross terms, and the two are NOT separable from this family: no two members share a draw and no member was repeated under a different initialization.
CSTAT-O2_is_it_entitled_to_the_name_C_st.alternative_reading: genuine amplification of the data fluctuation by the iterative unfolding, which would be legitimately statistical and would itself be a significant result
CSTAT-O2_is_it_entitled_to_the_name_C_st.discriminating_test_CSTAT-O2a: re-TRAIN one replica index twice at the SAME bootstrap_seed, then extract both. Extraction is deterministic given weights, so repeating extraction alone measures nothing -- the repeat must be of TRAINING. 3-5 same-seed retrains bound C_train at ~14 min per task.
CSTAT-O2_is_it_entitled_to_the_name_C_st.blocks: publication under the name C_stat, not build

assertions.symmetry: C == C.T BITWISE, enforced by construction, NOT by symmetrizing a nearly-symmetric result
assertions.symmetry_reason: a builder that symmetrizes hides whether its two triangles agreed
assertions.eigenvalues_reported_not_clipped: the smallest will be zero or numerically negative and that is EXPECTED per CSTAT-O1
